Free variable ⇒ ∞ solutions: FALSE unless consistent. Pivot in every row of [A | b] ⇒ consistent: FALSE.
Echelon form unique: FALSE (RREF is). Ax = b solution set is a span: FALSE if b ≠ 0.
Dependent ⇒ every vector is a combination of the others: FALSE (some vector). Pairwise non-parallel ⇒ independent: FALSE (3+ vectors).
T(0) = 0 ⇒ linear: FALSE. Wide matrix one-to-one / tall matrix onto: never.
(A + B)⁻¹ = A⁻¹ + B⁻¹, det(A + B) = det A + det B, det(cA) = c det A: all FALSE.
If det A = 0 then two rows are proportional: FALSE. Row ops preserve Col A / eigenvalues: FALSE (they preserve Nul A, Row A, rank).
Diagonalizable ⇔ invertible: FALSE both ways ([1 1; 0 1], diag(0, 1)). Diagonalizable ⇒ distinct eigenvalues: FALSE (I).
Same eigenvalues ⇒ similar: FALSE ([1 1; 0 1] vs I). Similar ⇒ same eigenvectors: FALSE.
Orthogonal set ⇒ independent: FALSE (may contain 0). Orthonormal columns ⇒ UUᵀ = I: FALSE unless square.
Least-squares x̂ is unique: FALSE unless columns independent. Projection formula with non-orthogonal basis: WRONG.
Singular values = |eigenvalues|: FALSE unless symmetric. Symmetric ⇒ orthogonally diagonalizable: TRUE (and conversely).
Repeated eigenvalue of x′ = Ax ⇒ t·e^(λt) terms: FALSE if eigenspace full. tr A < 0 ⇒ stable (2×2): FALSE (need det > 0).
Fourier series = f at jumps: FALSE (average). Sine series at 0 equals f(0⁺): FALSE (0).
